title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky
subtitle: Wake up as a Pokémon
summary: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky is Chunsoft's expanded Nintendo DS role-playing adventure built on Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness. A human transformed into a Pokémon joins a partner and becomes part of an exploration team. Their work takes them into shifting dungeons, where movement, supplies and turn-based encounters determine whether a mission can be completed safely. The premise places the creatures themselves at the centre of the story. Choosing a partner becomes the beginning of a relationship with somebody who shares both the danger and the discoveries.
body: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky is Chunsoft's expanded Nintendo DS role-playing adventure built on Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness. A human transformed into a Pokémon joins a partner and becomes part of an exploration team. Their work takes them into shifting dungeons, where movement, supplies and turn-based encounters determine whether a mission can be completed safely. The premise places the creatures themselves at the centre of the story. Choosing a partner becomes the beginning of a relationship with somebody who shares both the danger and the discoveries.

The party explores a grid of rooms and corridors whose arrangement can change between visits. Movement gives nearby enemies an opportunity to act, so stepping toward an item or another passage is also a tactical choice. Supplies and the condition of the team affect how far it is sensible to continue. This rhythm makes exploration and fighting part of the same activity. The next decision may be a simple movement across one square, but it can expose the partner to another attack or bring the pair closer to a needed resource.

Explorers of Sky adds playable starting choices and Special Episodes that develop supporting characters beyond their roles in the main adventure. Those additions explain its identity as an expanded edition rather than a separate beginning to the exploration story. The central partnership still provides its emotional anchor, while the additional perspectives make the surrounding cast more substantial. A game about finding one's place among Pokémon gains from allowing other members of that world to have journeys of their own, including circumstances the main pair would not otherwise experience.
story_headings: A dungeon changes one turn at a time
More lives around the central journey
